script: Want to save on your energy bill? Try this smart plug! It can reportedly cut your energy costs by up to 50% by scheduling devices to turn off when you're not home. You just plug it in, connect it to your Wi-Fi, and control everything from your phone. In our testing, we saw a noticeable drop in our monthly bill. It’s a simple gadget that pays for itself!
